claim: Hedy Lamarr was born on Nov. 9, 1914, in Vienna, Austria.
notes: Single-source secondary claim from IHH's current page; needs independent corroboration. Suspected error on IHH page: the birth year 1914 conflicts with the NARA/LoC authority heading 'Lamarr, Hedy, 1913-2000' (birth year 1913) and the variant heading 'Kiesler, Hedwig, 1915-' (1915). The page cites no source for the date; confirm the year against a primary record (e.g. the naturalization petition LAM-S-0001).

evidence.locator: line 65, header field 'Place & Date of Immigration'

notes: Single-source secondary claim from IHH's current page; needs independent corroboration.
